name: fitness-mcp
description: Semantic Fitness Layer exposed through MCP for model-agnostic AI fitness coaching.
long_description: Evidra turns the evidence a caller already holds into a training decision — not advice invented from nothing, but a well-supported transition from the current training state to the next, grounded in the evidence submitted and the rules applied. All computation is performed on the server. The server does not fetch, store, or retain evidence, nor does it invoke or rely on any model of its own.

tools.name: evidra_assess_fitness_state
tools.description: Read today's recovery and training state from submitted evidence. Reports state only; never says what to train.

tools.name: evidra_decide_session
tools.description: Decide what today's scheduled session should become, returning from -> to with the evidence behind the change.

tools.name: evidra_decide_exercise_substitution
tools.description: Decide what a movement the user cannot do today should be replaced with, returning from -> to with contraindications hard-filtered.

tools.name: evidra_generate_plan
tools.description: Build a training plan when the user has no plan in hand.

tools.name: evidra_preview_adjust_plan
tools.description: Show what adjusting an existing plan would change, without applying it.

tools.name: evidra_commit_adjust_plan
tools.description: Compute the plan a previewed adjustment produces, once the user has accepted the preview. The caller keeps the result; this server stores nothing.
